This petition was called on for hearing today.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJAY KISHAN KAUL  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUDHANSHU DHULIA

For Petitioner(s) Mr. Prakash Kumar Singh, Adv.
 Mr. Vishnu Kant Panday, Adv.
 Mr. Simanta Kumar, Adv.
 Mr. Rajeev Singh, AOR  For Respondent(s) Mr. Samir Ali Khan, AOR  Mr. Krishna M Singh, Adv.
 Mr. Rajivkumar, AOR  Mr. Upender Thakur, Adv.
 Mr. Sanjeev Gupta, Adv.
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Application for exemption from filing official translation is allowed.

On hearing learned counsel for parties, prima petitioner that in view of the FIR registered qua allegation under Sections 498A/34, IPC and Sections 3/47 of the Dowry Prohibition Act in the year Mithlesh Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98913566/
1 2015 in respect of which trial is stated to be pending, there cannot be a second FIR on the same cause.

sentences.text: However, the second FIR filed in the year 2019 also makes an allegation about the second marriage and in support of the same respondent No.2 has filed their counter affidavit.
In view of the aforesaid, learned counsel for the State requests for two weeks time to file an appropriate affidavit regarding this aspect.
The petitioner is permitted to file a rejoinder to both the counter affidavits within two weeks thereafter.

(ASHA SUNDRIYAL) (POONAM VAID)
ASTT. REGISTRAR-cum-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
